LanguageData.Raven_Biome_RavenLiquidMediterranean.des: Milky-white raven liquid pools into a broad inland sea across this lowland, with thin slivers of land drifting like sandbars between viscous lakes. There is almost no solid landmass here, only a few soft shorelines to set foot on.
LanguageData.Raven_Biome_RavenLiquidOceanIslands.desc: Island chains in the open ocean are surrounded by vast expanses of milky raven liquid. The islands still retain enough soil and vegetation for colonists to establish outposts, but every coastline drops off into a viscous, deep sea of raven liquid.
LanguageData.Raven_Biome_RavenLiquidSwamp.label: [Raven] Liquid Swamp
LanguageData.Raven_Biome_RavenLiquidSwamp.description: In these warm lowlands, raven liquid seeps into the peat and waterways, forming a lush white swamp. Resources are more abundant here, but movement is difficult, disease is frequent, and large expanses of shallow raven liquid block conventional routes.
